Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.http

Class ApacheHttpClient

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.http.ApacheHttpClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
GeoServerHttpClient, Closeable, AutoCloseable
public class ApacheHttpClient extends Object implements GeoServerHttpClient
Apache HttpClient 5 implementation of GeoServerHttpClient.

Uses Basic Authentication with pre-emptive header injection (no 401 challenge round-trip). Timeouts and connection pool size are configurable via constructor parameters.

Thread safety: a single instance wraps one pooled CloseableHttpClient and holds no other mutable state, so it is safe to share across threads. Create one instance per GeoServer endpoint (typically via GeoServerClient.builder()) and reuse it — do not construct a new client per request.

  • Field Details

    • DEFAULT_MAX_CONNECTIONS

      public static final int DEFAULT_MAX_CONNECTIONS
      Default max concurrent connections. Apache HttpClient's own default (2 per route) is too low for a client that talks to a single GeoServer host under any real concurrency.

      public ApacheHttpClient(String baseUrl, String username, String password, int connectTimeoutMs, int responseTimeoutMs)
      Creates a new Apache HTTP client for GeoServer communication with the default connection pool size (50).
      Parameters:
      baseUrl - GeoServer base URL (e.g., "http://localhost:8080/geoserver")
      username - GeoServer username
      password - GeoServer password
      connectTimeoutMs - connection timeout in milliseconds
      responseTimeoutMs - response timeout in milliseconds

    • ApacheHttpClient

      public ApacheHttpClient(String baseUrl, String username, String password, int connectTimeoutMs, int responseTimeoutMs, int maxConnections)
      Creates a new Apache HTTP client for GeoServer communication.
      Parameters:
      baseUrl - GeoServer base URL (e.g., "http://localhost:8080/geoserver")
      username - GeoServer username
      password - GeoServer password
      connectTimeoutMs - connection timeout in milliseconds
      responseTimeoutMs - response timeout in milliseconds
      maxConnections - max concurrent connections to the GeoServer host (this client only ever talks to one host, so total and per-route limits are the same)

    • getBinary

      public GeoServerResponse getBinary(String path, String accept)
      Description copied from interface: GeoServerHttpClient
      Performs a GET request and returns the raw binary response body.

      For 2xx responses the returned GeoServerResponse carries binary data via GeoServerResponse.getBinaryBody(). For non-2xx responses the text body is preserved in GeoServerResponse.getBody() for error-message extraction.

      Specified by:

      Parameters:

      accept - Accept header value (e.g., "application/zip")
